test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 Nov, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question: In an election between two candidates, 64% of the voters cast their votes, out of which 4% of the votes were declared invalid. A candidate got 12,288 votes which were 64% of the total valid votes. Find the total number of votes enrolled in that election.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Successive fraction calculation using percentage conversions:

Total voters × (16/25) × (24/25) × (16/25) = 12,288

⇒ Total voters = 12,288 × (25/16) × (25/24) × (25/16)

⇒ Total voters = 2 × 25 × 25 × 25 = 31,250

**∴ The correct answer is 31,250.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Percentage of enrolled voters who cast their votes = 64%

Percentage of votes declared invalid = 4% ⇒ Percentage of valid votes = 96%

Votes received by the candidate = 12,288 (which is 64% of valid votes)

**Method Used:**

We apply the successive percentage calculation to find the original total.

 
 Enrolled Votes (x)
 
 
 Cast Votes

 
 Valid Votes

 
 12,288 Votes

 

 

 64% Cast

 

 

 96% Valid

 

 

 64% Got

 x × 64% × 96% × 64% = 12,288

**Calculations:**

Let the total number of enrolled voters be x.

⇒ Number of votes cast = 64% of x = (16/25) × x

⇒ Invalid votes = 4% ⇒ Valid votes = 96% of Cast votes = (24/25) × (16/25) × x

⇒ Votes received by the candidate = 64% of Valid votes

⇒ (16/25) × (24/25) × (16/25) × x = 12,288

⇒ x = 12,288 × (25/16) × (25/24) × (25/16)

⇒ x = (12,288 ÷ 16) × 25 × (25/24) × (25/16)

⇒ x = (768 ÷ 24) × 25 × 25 × (25/16)

⇒ x = (32 ÷ 16) × 625 × 25

⇒ x = 2 × 15,625 = 31,250

**∴ The correct answer is 31,250.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Election Base Percentage

The total number of voters on the voting list is always considered as the base (100%). All subsequent percentages regarding cast votes are calculated on this base.

Valid vs Invalid Votes

Invalid votes are strictly deducted from the total votes cast. Only the valid votes are considered for determining the winning and losing candidate's share.

Successive Percentage Method

When percentages are applied sequentially, multiply the continuous factors directly: Final Value = Base × P₁% × P₂% × P₃%.

Reverse Calculation Trick

To find the initial base value from the final resultant value, simply multiply the final value by the reciprocals of the fraction equivalents of each percentage.
